title: Real projects: the user's ETABS models
purpose: Every ETABS model dropped into the RealProjects folder is run in ETABS as its author set it up, exported to text (.$et), imported into SkyFrame and run there. Base reactions, periods and mass ratios, story drifts and the largest joint displacements are compared program against program (python compare_real.py); there is no hand calculation.

settings.model: as the project's author built it (the EDB is opened unchanged; a copy is analysed)
settings.analysis: the cases the model has set to run; all of its cases when none is set
settings.solver: ETABS advanced solver, all cores; SkyFrame default
settings.transfer: ETABS text export (.$et) read by SkyFrame's e2k importer
